data.gender_notes: Unni is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Unni means younger brother in Malayalam and is also a name for the Hindu god Shiva. In Sanskrit, Unni is derived from the root 'un' which means new, and 'ni' meaning born. The name Unni carries the meaning “Younger brother, god” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Malayalam. Parents who choose Unni usually hope their child will grow to embody younger brother, god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the younger brother or the younger aspect of a god. Represents the idea of new beginnings and growth.
data.etymology: Unni belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Younger brother, god.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Unni total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
